considerations: Known provisioning and inventory apps may produce this pattern.
Inspect Graph permissions and the associated sign-in session.
description: Look for a cloud principal querying many Graph user or group paths in quick succession.

evidence.claim: Microsoft observed ARTEX-associated use of exposed cloud credentials, service-principal sign-ins from a reported IP, rapid cloud discovery and attempted access to Azure Key Vault and other resources.
evidence.location: Credential abuse via Entra ID and indicators sections

expected_output: One row per principal, app, source IP and five-minute window.

history.summary: Created evidence-backed hunt and validated all supported variants.

hypothesis: Look for a cloud principal querying many Graph user or group paths in quick succession.
performance: Time filter first, then table-specific predicates and a narrow projection.
scope: Evidence review, static checks, Microsoft Kusto syntax and schema analysis. Engine and workspace execution not run.
title: Burst of App-Only Directory Enumeration

1.json:
MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where RequestMethod == "GET" and isnotempty(ServicePrincipalId)
| where tostring(parse_url(RequestUri).Path) has_any ("users", "groups", "servicePrincipals")
| summarize Calls = count(), Paths = dcount(tostring(parse_url(RequestUri).Path)), Successes = countif(ResponseStatusCode between (200 .. 299)) by AppId, ServicePrincipalId, IPAddress, Window = bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where Calls >= 30 and Paths >= 10
| order by Calls desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
